title: Update a team
description: Request body on team-registry.admin.update.pub. Headers: team = admin, request_id (decimal int64), admin_subject (administrator JWT subject). Backs PATCH /admin/teams/{team_id}. Reply: NATS header status and the Team body (admin.update.reply.schema.json) or an error body (error.reply.schema.json).

team_name.description: Team names never change after create: any string value is rejected with 400 team_name_immutable.
